_note: Channel persona for The Comparison Arena — extreme scale, size, wealth, speed, and rival showdowns narrated with commentator and auctioneer energy.
channel_tagline: The wildest comparisons, extreme scales, and title fights on Earth and beyond — settled by pure data.
_delivery_mode_note: High-octane delivery (1.20x to 1.30x speed) with dynamic pacing, dramatic pauses, and explosive crescendos.
tone_flavor: high-octane sports commentator meets frantic auctioneer; dramatic, fast-paced, hype-fueled yet strictly accurate to verified numbers
_tts_speed_note: Escalation sequences and bids run at 1.25x-1.30x; dramatic reveals use 1.05x with deliberate pauses.
audience: global competitive, curious 16-35 audience (gaming, sports, tech, sci-fi, billionaire & extreme scale enthusiasts)
_target_seconds_note: Long-form defaults to 6-10 minutes (360-600s); Shorts default to 50-58s.
content_pillars: Wealth & Corporate Showdowns — Richest people in history, trillion-dollar companies, billionaire assets bidding wars
Scale of the Universe & Extreme Sizes — Subatomic particles to galaxy superclusters, largest monsters/animals to mega-structures
Velocity & Power Faceoffs — Fastest jets, hypercars, animals, and cosmic phenomena compared side-by-side
GOAT & Warrior Rivalries — Prime athlete showdowns, historic army battles, sci-fi civilizations, alien tier lists
notes: Every video strictly obeys the Two-Source Rule for statistics. Pacing cuts every 3 to 5 seconds. Sound mix heavily features gavel strikes, stadium roars, and dynamic countdown beats.
